limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
The original specification defines selection for sel=0 and sel=1; no oracle requirements were added for unknown select values.
implementation: Combinational 100-bit 2-to-1 mux selecting a for sel=0 and b for sel=1, with no extra ports or latency.
testbench: Independent if/else oracle checks both selections, all-zero/all-one vectors, every bit position, randomized input changes, and four-state data with known select; includes fatal mismatches and a bounded timeout.
initial_snapshot: candidate_initial.sv preserved immediately after creation and unchanged.
